stats.description: the reader stats substances change (`testo`, `appetite`): baseline + half-life, ITEMS.md "Substances"

albums.description: the music media items carry (albums.ts), language-neutral

airlift_carriers.description: the creature airlift's carriers – one at random per flight (homes.ts, research/CAVE.md D8)

Catalog.description: The item catalog. `accepted_warnings` (here and on items / albums) are the admin's accepted catalog warnings (catalogWarningPlace): stored with the entries – a list-wide one in the meta entry `items` – never served to readers.

model.description: The item's 3D model (FEATURES 10.102, owner 2026-10-16: "We will turn all items into 3d assets"): a CDN-root `.glb` (ITEMS.md "3D item models" – metres, +Y up, front +Z). The item detail shows it instead of the icon (WebGL, no reduced motion); a variant may have its own. The LP's is its sleeve with the record inside (nodes `sleeve`, `record`) – the record player takes the record out (record-stage.js). None = the icon only.

vinyl.description: the record and sleeve as the shared base model (a look instead of a whole `.glb`); it wins over `model`

takeable.description: a story may take it from the reader (VN `takeItem` / a choice's `take`; owner 2026-10-07, BACKLOG 10.38) – never a physical item; off by default

wear.description: Wardrobe overlays of a wearable (ITEMS.md "Wardrobe"): `<character>` or `<character>/<slot instance id>` → CDN path of a full-body overlay aligned to that character's A-pose (768 × 1152, transparent WebP, convention `characters/<character>/wear/<item>[-<slot instance>].webp`). Not drawn since 2026-10-12 (items sit in the avatar page's slot tiles, ITEMS.md "Wardrobe"); kept for the dress-up research, it only picks the basic dress.

default_worn.description: Part of the basic dress (ITEMS.md "Wardrobe": T-shirt, shorts, sandals): a starter wearable that is put on when it is handed out (signup, older accounts, guests). A character without an overlay for it wears another starter of the same slot that has one instead (the swim pants on yellowmouse / Top Toy) – `basicDress`.

respawn.description: When a picked-up placement of this item is back on its slice (respawn.ts): a default interval and the range a placement may choose; none / null = it never reappears (a one-time find). Admin → Catalog can override it.

sound.description: the sound when a picked-up placement lands in the bag (agents/FX.md) – none = "pling", `none` = silent; a placement can choose its own (`SliceItem.sound`)

effects.description: a substance's stat changes (`catalog.stats` ids), ITEMS.md "Substances"

sober.description: sobers up (owner 2026-10-08: "eating candy reduces the effect to half the time … lots of cucumbers reduce the time it lasts"): each piece used takes this share (0 < x < 1) off the remaining time of every running reader effect – 0.5 halves it. An item with it is used like a substance (`apply` skill).

worn_tint.description: a wearable that tints what the reader sees while it is worn (owner 2026-10-08: "putting on some cool sunglasses will make everything orange hued"): a colour `#rrggbb`, laid over everything (multiply)

max.description: Collection limit: at most this many per account (owner 2026-10-02); none = `MAX_PER_ACCOUNT` (99). Rarer items set less. The server refuses more (409 max_reached); a claimed physical product (QR code) is always added.

placements.description: Item limits across the system (BACKLOG 10.39, ITEMS.md "Item limits"): how often it may be placed on slices, in every toon together (the creator: a Problems error, a paste refuses; the API: 422 item_limit on a save that adds one over it) – none = unlimited.

max_world.description: How many accounts may own it at once (1 = it exists only once in the world); the server refuses anyone else (409 taken) while that many own it – none = unlimited.

giftable.description: Can a reader gift it to another reader (ITEMS.md "Ownership, claims, gifting")? None = yes, except starters / the basic dress and membership / access-only items (`isGiftable`). The server decides (403 not_giftable).

album.description: A media item's album (`catalog.albums` id) and its sound carrier (agents/ITEMS.md "Players, albums, related items"): it plays in the app only for a reader who owns a player of that format.

plays.description: A player: the formats it plays (`record_player` → `['vinyl']`)

holds.description: A container (containers.ts, research/SCORES.md §2b): what it holds, how many, an overfill that breaks it

ages.description: It ages from its creation: tint, then spots (the DIY song book; containers.ts `ageLook`)

score.description: A score's files – MusicXML for the score view, the print PDF (one language per score)

furniture.description: Furniture: its size and picture in a home, a workbench (homes.ts, research/CAVE.md D4)

ItemCategory.description: `food` = eaten with the `apply` skill ("Essen" instead of "Benutzen"), e.g. the cucumber and the tuna can lower appetite; `score` = sheet music (`ItemDef.score`, research/SCORES.md); `furniture` = stands in a home (`ItemDef.furniture`, homes.ts); `bag` = a carried container (a CD case, a DJ trolley, a record bag – `ItemDef.holds`, research/PACKING.md)

format.description: the base model: `lp12` = a 12" LP (Ø 302 mm) – a 7" single, a cassette … follow as further base models

sleeveFront.description: the printed sleeve's front (~1024 px); none = a plain paper inner sleeve (a test press)

sleeveBack.description: its back (~768 px) and spine (a narrow strip); none = plain card

labelA.description: the labels, square pictures of the round label (~512 px); none = a blank white label

VinylLook.description: A shared base model built in code (owner 2026-10-16: "dass wir insgesamt auch ganz oft Shared 3D-Modelle anlegen können"): the record and its sleeve are the same for every LP – an item gives only what differs, its pictures (CDN-root WebP paths) and colour (ITEMS.md "3D item models"). `@scutoons/media/vinyl-model` builds it.

labels.description: ImageNet class words that count as a hit (MobileNet on the device)

per_day.description: at most this many scan grants of `grants` per account in 24 h (server: 429 daily_limit); none = no daily limit

name.description: what the camera says it recognised for `labels` ("Pillendose"); none = the matched model label

map.description: More things to find (the multi-label Check It camera, ITEMS.md "Substances"): recognised labels → the item they grant, checked together with `labels` → `grants` (the best match wins) – `scanTargets` / `matchScan`.

PlayAudioSkill.deprecated:
(2026-10-02) the music belongs to an album now: a media item has `album` + `format` and plays only with a
player (`plays`), albums.ts. Still read gracefully (`legacyPlayAudio`): plays without a player.

ApplySkill.description: "Benutzen" applies a substance ("Essen" for `food`): one piece is used up, its `effects` / `effect` hit the reader (substances.ts)

EnterHomeSkill.description: "Nach Hause" from anywhere – the VR headset (research/CAVE.md D2): enters the reader's home without walking there

model.description: this variant's own 3D model (CDN-root `.glb`); none = the item's `model`

worn_tint.description: this variant's tint while worn (owner 2026-10-08: sunglasses in six colours as variants); none = the item's `worn_tint`

wear.description: this variant's wardrobe overlays (`ItemDef.wear`'s keys); none = the item's

ItemRespawn.description: An item's respawn rule (`ItemDef.respawn`; none / null = it never reappears, a one-time find). `min` / `max` = the shortest / longest interval a placement may choose (default: only `default`'s own length … any longer one). The intervals and their periods are the shared recurrence model (recurrence.ts).

RecurrenceInterval.description: Every page view (`visit`: a new page or a reload starts a new one), or every n minutes / hours / days.

TimedInterval.description: A timed interval: every n minutes / hours / days (n a whole number ≥ 1, at most a year).

FxSoundChoice.description: a sound choice in content: one of the sounds, or `none` (none set = the effect's own)

delta.description: added to the current (decayed) level, then clamped to 0–100

StatEffect.description: One stat change of a substance.

TimedEffect.description: A temporary reader effect of a substance (`READER_EFFECTS`): active until now + duration.

overfill.description: A soft limit (the DIY song book, owner 2026-10-14): past `max` up to `overfill.max` after a warning; overfilled for `days` it breaks into `breaks_into` (its contents fall out). Taking entries out back to `max` in time saves it.

ItemHolds.description: What a container takes (owner 2026-10-14: "a simple rule we can edit"): an item fits when its category is listed OR its id is listed OR its sound-carrier `format` is listed (owner 2026-10-16: CDs into a CD case / tower, LPs into a DJ trolley / record bag / shelf, tapes into the cassette rack – research/PACKING.md §3); `max` = how many pieces fit (none = no limit). A container never holds a container.

ItemAges.description: An item that ages from its creation (the DIY song book): a tint from `tint_days`, spots from `spots_days`, fully aged at `full_days`.

parts.description: Named parts of the same score (owner 2026-10-14: one item per song, "different parts" – no second item): `choir` = the choir arrangement. Switched on per reader later with live mode's performance groups; for now the reader sees `READER_PART` when the score has it (`readerPart`).

collage.description: collage pieces on the full score (collage.ts, agents/research/COLLAGE.md §4): edited in the creator's score stage, never in the public catalog – readers get the pieces with the signed file

ScoreFiles.description: A score's files (one language per score – an edition per language, owner 2026-10-14): CDN paths, served signed.

file.description: the vault path it was placed on; another file on the part = "check the bars"

pieces.description: back → front within each side (over / behind)

src.description: the file, in the host's path form: a toon document's `toonAssetRef`, a catalog row's CDN-root path

ratio.description: the file's width ÷ height, copied at pick time – laid out before load, never distorted

rect.description: x / y = the `anchor` point, the width; the height always follows `ratio` (never stored). Slice: % of the picture. Score (music): x = % of the bar's time (0 = its first beat, 100 = its end – it follows the notes, so a piece on a note stays on it whatever the line breaks), y = staff spaces below the staff's top line, width = staff spaces. Score (`at.page`): % of the page.

preset.description: a CollageLook id (a code look's or a custom preset's); none = as drawn – readers get custom presets baked

behind.description: scores only: under the notes; default over

CollagePiece.description: one piece on a slice or a score (array order = paint order, back to front)

PieceFigure.description: How a character picture was picked (the editor re-resolves `src` from it); the renderer draws `src` only. Not `character`: that key makes ChapterFiles save the whole persona offline and the Library add it to the cast.

fill.description: the file's silhouette (its alpha) in a colour / gradient; none = as drawn

PieceStyle.description: a colouration – a look's values, or a piece's own over its look (a key replaces it whole; null = off)

PieceColor.description: #rgb | #rrggbb – it reaches readers' CSS as written, so nothing else is a colour (no url(), no `;`)

angle.description: CSS degrees, 0 = to the top; default 180

PieceGradient.description: one linear gradient across the whole silhouette

PieceOutline.description: lengths in % of the piece's width (the same look at every size)

PieceShadow.description: offsets and blur in % of the piece's width

PieceBlur.description: in % of the piece's width; even, or with `from` + `to`: sharp at `from`, `amount` from `to` on (progressive)

PiecePoint.description: % of the piece's own box (0 0 top-left … 100 100 bottom-right): moves, scales, turns with the piece

bar.description: the bar number as the file writes it (MusicXML measure@number = MEI measure@n): "12", "0", "6a"

nth.description: the n-th bar with that number; default 1

staff.description: the staff from the top (staff@n); default 1 – hidden in a condensed system: the bar's top staff

page.description: on the page that holds the bar (a background): `rect` in % of that page

ScoreAt.description: a score piece's place: a bar of the file – never a page, never a Verovio id

ItemFurniture.description: A furniture item (`ItemDef.furniture`, category `furniture`): how it stands in a home. `size` = its width in % of the room's width at the front edge (the room = 4 m: metres ÷ 4 × 100 – workflows/home/furniture.md); `image` = the piece as it stands in a home (three-quarter view, its back to the left wall, its foot at the bottom), next to the item's `icon`; `workshop` = recipes `at: "workshop"` run at it (the workbench).

image.description: the recipe's own picture (CDN path, `<toon>/items/recipes/<id>.webp`; owner 2026-10-04) – none = the output item's

at.description: where it can be made: `workshop` = only at a workbench in a home (the broken song book's repair, research/CAVE.md D4)

keep.description: an input that is kept – a tool like the drill, not an ingredient (research/SCORES.md §2a)

variant_from.description: the output only: its variant is taken from this input item's variant (the plastic's colour, an upgraded book's)

baseline.description: 0–100, the neutral start and where the level drifts back to

half_life_days.description: the distance to the baseline halves every N days

StatDef.description: A reader stat (`catalog.stats.<id>`): where it rests and how fast it gets back there.

toon.description: the toon it belongs to (null = cross-toon)

download.description: CDN-root path of the album download (a zip), if there is one – reachable without a player

cover.description: CDN-root path of a cover image, optional

access.description: who may download / listen (per album: one zip and one track list, whichever of its media items someone owns)

Album.description: An album: the music a media item carries (language-neutral; only the title is text)

title.description: the song's name (proper names are the same in every language)

src.description: CDN-root path of the streamable file (`<toon>/audio/music/<name>.128.mp3`; a physical release's in the vault: `albums/<album>/<hash>.mp3`) – the file when no variant fits

variants.description: one file per media quality level (low 96k / medium 128k / high 320k, owner 2026-10-16), like chapter audio; the reader's level picks one (`albumTrackFile`), a missing level falls back to the next lower one, else `src`

side.description: the record side it is on (owner 2026-10-16: "Roar, Cloud and Not My City is A, the rest B"); none = A (`trackSide`) – "Turn the record" switches to the other side's songs

QualityVariants.description: One file per quality level (CDN paths like `src`); a missing level falls back (`pickQualityVariant`).

download.description: who gets the album download (`download`), default `members` (the toon page's music download as before)

listen.description: who may listen in the app, default `owners`; a player for the format is always needed

image.description: the room's background, a still (MAP.md §5.1 three-quarter view), language-neutral; the video's poster

video.description: An animated background (owner 2026-10-14: "Die Cave-Hintergründe können auch Videos sein. Animierte kurze Clips"): a short muted loop (.mp4 / .webm) over the still; reduced motion or a failed load shows the still

HomeScene.description: A home scene (catalog `home_scenes`): what a home looks like – the 2.5D background (images first, 3D later)

HomeSceneMedia.description: A home scene's file at the reader's media quality (media-quality.ts `pickQualityVariant`): `src` = 1080p (low and medium), `variants.high` = 4K (owner 2026-10-14: "4K und 1080p ist, glaube ich, ausreichend für die Hintergründe")

image.description: its picture (a cut-out, CDN path), shown carrying the avatar during the flight

AirliftCarrier.description: A carrier of the creature airlift (catalog `airlift_carriers`, research/CAVE.md D8): a crazy creature or a flying robot taxi – one drawn at random per flight; the owner adds more without code
